OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor()/math.ceil() directly on datetime objects from AuditLogEntry, which raises TypeError since math.floor() doesn't work on datetime objects
OptimizedCursorPaginator.value_from_cursor returns raw cursor value without converting back to datetime, causing invalid SQL when comparing a number to a DateTimeField on subsequent pages

OptimizedCursorPaginator passes negative cursor.offset directly to Django queryset slicing, but Django raises AssertionError for negative slice indices despite the comment claiming Django handles negative slicing

The comment about negative offset handling being for 'authorized administrators' is misleading since has_global_access defaults to True for all org members, exposing the buggy paginator to more users than intended
Users with org:write scope can trigger a 500 error by crafting a cursor with negative offset (e.g., '0:-5:0'), creating a denial-of-service vector for the audit logs feature
